To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the 24S complex of aminoacyl-tRNAs synthetase from the rat liver contains 12 synthetases, and that the lysyl-tRNA is the most stable synthetase in the complex.
lysyl-tRNA synthatase is a component of a large protein complex, the 24S complex.

the high molecular weight amino acyl-tRNA synthethase complex (the "24S complex") was isolated from rat livers, the lysyl-tRNA synthease (E.C 6.1,1.6) from the complex was purified approximately 2700 fold by hydrophobic chromatography, hydroxylapatte chromatography, and DEAE chromatograpgy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the purification of the lysyl-tRNA from rat liver.
the purification of a number of aminoacyl-tRNAs from rat liver.
the purification of a lysyl-tRNA from rat liver.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the lysyl-tRNA synthease from the rat liver 24S complex is a monomer with a subunit molecular weight of approximately 70 000 daltons and is not a component of the 24S complex.

the lysyl-tRNA synthatase isolated from the 24s complex was a homogeneous protein as determined by the following criteria: (1) the protein migrated as a single band on polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis, (2) the protein migrated with an apparent molecular weight of 65,000 on SDS gel electrophoresiis, and (3) the protein had a single amino acid composition.
the lysyl-tRNA-synthetase from rat-liver is a single enzyme, that is, the lysyl-tRNAsynthetase is not a complex of two or more different enzymes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have isolated and purified the lysyl-tRNA from rat liver and have shown its aminoacylation activity.
lysyl-tRNA synthatse was successfully dissociated from the high molecular weight 24S complex and purified to a high degree of purity.
the 24S complex is a high molecular weight complex containing all of the aminoacyl-tRNAsynthetases and the elongation factors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the high molecular weight synthetase complex is not an artifact of the isolation procedure, but rather an in vivo complex.

we have shown the existence of a high molecular weight amino-acyl tRNA synthetase containing complex (24S synthetases complex) in rat liver and have isolated the lysyl-tRNA synthease from this complex.
the 24S complex is not a simple aggregation of aminoacyl-t RNA synthetases, but rather a complex of synthetases and other proteins that are involved in translation.
